_about: Per-type settings for scripts/build.py (FACTORY-2). A page type exists when src/templates/<type>.html exists and has an entry here. schema: 'article' (Article JSON-LD, Published and Updated byline) or 'webpage' (WebPage JSON-LD plus the source's optional Service node). byline: the fsc region scripts/byline.py renders (byline-article, line-state, line-asset or byline-framework; byline.py adds the signature on note and framework pages). mode: 'reference' or 'article'. house: the house stylesheet partial. page_css: an extra stylesheet partial inlined on the page, or null. cite: 'case' for [n] links or 'fn' for superscript notes. article_section: the Article's articleSection. range: body words [min, max] (ruling 3), read by scripts/qa/pagecheck.py. figures: the counted-figure table of amendment A6 for the type, read by scripts/qa/pagecheck.py. The practice, framework and note entries and their house partials (FACTORY-2B, METHOD-1 request 1, extracted byte for byte from the served pages) wait for METHOD-1's template files; a type exists only once its template does.
